claims.evidence: Witness report notes no clear readable brand/model text on the frame in the photo.
No photo evidence about intended use or exercise suitability beyond it being a bicycle.
Front suspension fork is visible in the photo.
Drivetrain area looks present/assembled, but the exact gear system type/count is not readable.

risks.risk: Tires may be worn, cracked, or not holding air (not shown).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires (tread + sidewalls) and a short clip showing the bike rolling and the tires not visibly flat.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a bicycle with unknown tire condition (assume tires may need replacement).

risks.risk: Brakes may not work properly (bite/stop power not shown).
risks.proof: Video clip squeezing the brake levers while stationary, showing disc rotor movement and no rubbing/warping; also a short stop test on a flat surface.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes needing inspection/possible service.

risks.risk: Gears may not shift smoothly or may slip (not shown).
risks.proof: Video clip shifting through all gears while pedaling, showing clean engagement and no skipping/slipping.
risks.if_unproven: Price as gears untested/possibly needing adjustment.

risks.risk: Wheel alignment/bearing issues (true/straight, rim dents, bearing play not shown).
risks.proof: Photo/clip of wheels spun to show wobble; also a hand-check clip for bearing play at front and rear axles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as wheels/bearings unknown (assume possible service).

risks.risk: Frame damage or rust/cracks not visible from the single angle.
risks.proof: Full 360° photos of frame, fork, and joints (top tube, down tube, seat stays, chain stays, head tube) plus close-ups of any suspicious spots.
risks.if_unproven: Price as frame condition unknown (worst-case minor damage).

risks.risk: Brand/model and exact spec may be different from what the seller claims.
risks.proof: Clear photo of any brand/model markings on the frame/fork and on the drivetrain components (shifters/derailleurs/cassette).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic hybrid/fitness bicycle with front suspension (no premium for claimed brand).

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of the frame/fork for any brand/model text (and drivetrain component markings).
Provide a short video of braking (disc) and a stop test on a flat road.
Provide a short video shifting through all gears while pedaling (showing no skipping/slipping).
Send close-up photos of tire tread and sidewalls on both wheels, plus a quick check that tires hold air.
Send wheel spin/wobble video and a bearing play check at front and rear.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a bicycle type and confirms visible front suspension and disc brake, so a worst-case price can be set for an unverified brand/spec with untested functional condition.
